document: Forming a New Congregation — Master Checklist

project.name: Ashburton Tagalog Congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses, Ashburton, New Zealand

notes.forms-number-blank: Signed S-51 attachment: the proposed congregation-number field is blank.
notes.req-population: 9 August email and signed S-51: local census, Tagalog-language, and Mid Canterbury estimates were presented with the stated significant Tagalog-speaking need.
notes.req-language-need: Signed S-51 reason: publishers and Bible students depend on Tagalog for spiritual instruction and progress.
notes.req-publishers-students: 9 August email and signed S-51: 35 publishers, 46 Bible studies, and 34 reported progressive studies support the recorded language need and spiritual activity.
notes.req-mature-core: Signed S-51 reason: a stable and spiritually mature core of fluent publishers is present.
notes.req-appointed-sufficient: 9 August email and signed S-51: 5 elders and 2 ministerial servants; the signed reason states appointed brothers can provide shepherding and care for congregation responsibilities.
notes.warning-no-students: Checked against the 9 August email: this warning sign is not present; 46 studies and 34 reported progressive studies were recorded.
notes.warning-one-appointed: Checked against the 9 August email: this warning sign is not present; 5 elders and 2 ministerial servants were recorded.
notes.warning-fluency-oversight: Checked against the signed S-51 reason: this warning sign is not present; it records a fluent mature core and appointed brothers capable of oversight.
notes.warning-individual-review: The 9 August email reviews Ashburton's own population, language, publisher, study, attendance, and appointed-brother evidence and explicitly states its limitations.
notes.s51-total-active: Signed S-51 attachment and 9 August email: Total active is recorded as 31.
notes.s51-baptized: Signed S-51 attachment: Baptized is recorded as 31.
notes.s51-regular-pioneers: Signed S-51 attachment and 9 August email: 10 regular pioneers are recorded.
notes.s51-elders: Signed S-51 attachment and 9 August email: 5 elders are recorded.
notes.s51-ms: Signed S-51 attachment and 9 August email: 2 ministerial servants are recorded.
notes.s51-reasons: Signed S-51 attachment contains the completed factual reason for forming the congregation.
notes.s51-start: Signed S-51 attachment and 9 August email record November 2026 as the proposed start month—not branch approval.
notes.final-language: The 9 August email documents population, Tagalog-language, spiritual-need, fluency, publisher, study, attendance, and appointed-brother evidence.
notes.approval-wait: Completed: the branch approval letter is dated 2 September 2026.
notes.approval-letter: Official two-page branch approval letter AUS2824311_1 received and reviewed.
notes.approval-date: The approved start date is 1 November 2026.
notes.approval-official-name: Approved complete name: Ashburton Tagalog Congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses, Ashburton, New Zealand.
notes.approval-circuit-identity: Official identity: congregation 3814, Circuit NZ-2, circuit overseer Anthony Radi.
